description: This file defines a LoggerSubscriber class that listens for exception events within the application and logs error messages and stack traces using a Logger service.

classes.name: LoggerSubscriber
classes.description: A subscriber that listens for kernel exception events and logs error details

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping kernel exception events to handler methods, subscribing 'onExceptionEvent' with high priority

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Handles an exception event by retrieving the exception and logging its message and trace

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Defines the event subscriptions for this subscriber

methods.name: onExceptionEvent
methods.description: Logs exception details when an exception event occurs
